response.text:
**Gefitinib** is a well-known EGFR (epidermal growth factor receptor) tyrosine kinase inhibitor, used clinically for certain non-small-cell lung cancers. Its ChEMBL molecule ID is **CHEMBL939**.

Note: I attempted to confirm this directly via the ChEMBL API in this session, but the service returned HTTP 500 errors on each query (the API status check succeeded, showing ChEMBL_37 as up, but the specific molecule lookups failed). The ID CHEMBL939 for gefitinib is well-established and consistent across ChEMBL and other public references (e.g., DrugBank, PubChem cross-references), but I was not able to re-verify it live against the ChEMBL database in this session due to those API errors — you may want to double-check at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/ if exact confirmation is critical for your use case.
